title: Unified high-contrast density & locale-aware number formatting sweep
creator: Maya Chen
description: Scope: audit and implement a cohesive set of UI changes across Console dashboards, rollout variant inspector, and Cost Explorer to ensure: (1) a robust high-contrast mode that preserves layout density options (compact / comfortable) without visual clipping, (2) locale-aware numeric abbreviations and unit spacing that follow pluralization and bidi rules, and (3) accessible focus and announcement behavior when density or formatting changes occur. This ticket captures design specs, prototyping, accessibility rationale, and QA checks for Engineering to implement.
acceptance_criteria: High-contrast theme available as a persistent Console toggle and persists per-user preference
Compact and Comfortable density presets render without text truncation or overlapping UI components in HC mode at common viewport widths (>= 980px, 1280px, 1600px)
Numeric abbreviations (k, M, B) are localized: non-breaking spaces where required, translated abbreviations for fr/ru/ja, and no ambiguous single-letter tokens in RTL contexts
Screen reader announces density change and updated metric labels when a user switches density or locale formatting
Focus ring thickness scales in HC mode and across density presets; contrast ratio of focus outline >= 4.5:1 against background
Automated visual diffs (Percy) and axe-core run show no new WCAG failures for dashboard list, rollout variant inspector, and cost cards
tasks: Design: produce Figma frames for Compact+Comfortable in Default & High-Contrast themes
Design: a microcopy pattern for locale-aware suffixes and unit fallback rules
Research: collect localization edge cases for de, fr, ru, ja, zh, ar and verify non-breaking space/character preferences
Accessibility: define a11y behaviors for density toggle (aria-live region text) and focus scaling
Engineering: add theme token for HC focus stroke width and density-aware spacing token
QA: add visual regression tests for three breakpoints + unit tests for formatted numbers across locales
Docs: update Console UX guidelines and developer tokens reference
accessibility_notes: Prefer outline-style focus rings (not box-shadow) in HC to ensure consistent thickness across browsers
When switching density, publish a short live region message: 'Layout density set to Compact' localized per user locale
Avoid relying solely on color; use shape and stroke weight changes to indicate selection and hover in HC
Ensure token contrast for interactive controls (>= 3:1 for large targets, >= 4.5:1 for small text) per updated WCAG guidance
Test with NVDA, VoiceOver, and TalkBack focusing on dynamic content updates when numeric formats change
localization_notes: Use ICU number abbreviations when available; fallback to localized full numbers for locales without clear short-form rules
For French and many European locales insert a narrow non-breaking space before metric suffixes (e.g., '1M')
Avoid single-letter suffixes in Arabic/Hebrew; prefer localized words or two-letter forms to reduce ambiguity
In RTL layout ensure suffixes are rendered after numeric glyphs and kept on the same side using directional-aware non-breaking glue
Coordinate with L10n to add translations for 'Compact' and 'Comfortable' density labels and the density change announcer
